description: This file defines logging utilities for distributed checkpoint operations in PyTorch, including functions for creating log message dictionaries, a decorator for logging method execution, and logger initialization.

methods.name: _msg_dict_from_dcp_method_args
methods.description: Extracts log data from checkpoint method arguments.

methods.name: _get_msg_dict
methods.description: Combines message dictionaries from method args and logger.

methods.name: _dcp_method_logger
methods.description: Decorator for logging start, end, and exceptions of functions.

methods.name: _init_logger
methods.description: Initializes the logger with a specific rank.
